title: Wilder Penfield and false memories

tellings.quote: named Dr. Wilder Penfield who was involved in early mind control stuff, you know, shows that this is true in mice.

plain: Wilder Penfield was a brain surgeon whom a podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes as involved in early mind control work. In a conversation about false memories, Michels says Penfield's work shows the idea holds true in mice. He brings it up to suggest that memories can be planted or changed, which would matter for people who say their own memories of strange events may have been altered.
